unit: One held-out real OCR prompt and evaluation seed, evaluated from the endpoint of a specified bounded SD3.5 Medium distillation run. A workload w identifies that prompt, its evaluation randomness, and a training-run specification: initialization, training corpus/order/randomness, fixed batch and accumulation settings, and a positive budget U of verified optimizer updates. Candidate and reference each train their own student from the same initialization for exactly U updates using the retained single-OCR-teacher kl_only path, then generate one 512-by-512 image for this prompt using 40 evaluation steps and noise_level=0. Training uses genuine 512-pixel trajectories with 10 rollout steps. Workloads sharing a training-run specification reuse that implementation's trained checkpoint; they remain separate prompt-and-seed comparisons. Every additional evaluation or training seed creates separate workloads, not measurements to average for the flag. The authoritative evaluator must execute the submitted pipeline and SDE bodies, student/teacher/base forwards, gradients and updates on a Driver-owned Verifier NVIDIA GPU runner; CPU PaddleOCR scoring does not make this a CPU workload. Suite cardinality, U and resource settings must be frozen in an author-private workload manifest after authorized GPU qualification, before grading any submission.

metrics.name: ocr_reward
metrics.means: The artifact's absolute OCR reward for the single generated image in workload w, in [0,1]. Extract the first double-quoted target from the real prompt, remove ASCII spaces and lowercase both target and concatenated recognized text, exactly as OcrScorer does. For nonempty normalized target t and recognized string s, d=0 if t is a substring of s, otherwise d=min(Levenshtein(s,t),len(t)); ocr_reward=1-d/len(t). An OCR exception receives the scorer's zero reward. This is the individual OCR measurement underlying the artifact's eval_reward_ocr, not a reward ratio, improvement over initialization, or teacher-distance proxy.
metrics.source: upstream/flow_grpo/ocr.py::OcrScorer.__call__ computes each image's reward; upstream/flow_grpo/rewards.py::ocr_score and ::multi_score expose it as score_details['ocr']; upstream/scripts/train_sd3.py::eval gathers these values, reports sampled image rewards in eval_images captions, and logs their mean as eval_reward_ocr. upstream/config/grpo.py::general_ocr_sd3_8gpu_opd selects reward_fn={'ocr': 1.0}.
metrics.clears_when: For workload w, C_w is the candidate's ocr_reward and R_w is the reference's ocr_reward under the identical frozen workload specification. clears_ocr_reward(w) = valid_candidate(w) AND valid_reference(w) AND isfinite(C_w) AND isfinite(R_w) AND (0 <= C_w <= 1) AND (0 <= R_w <= 1) AND (C_w > R_w when R_w < 1, else C_w >= R_w). Compare the unrounded values. Below the scorer's maximum equality fails; on a ceiling workload (R_w == 1) the candidate must also reach 1, where equality passes.

beats_reference: For the frozen, nonempty graded suite W, beats_reference = 1 iff suite_complete AND (AND over every w in W of [valid_candidate(w) AND valid_reference(w) AND isfinite(C_w) AND isfinite(R_w) AND 0 <= C_w <= 1 AND 0 <= R_w <= 1 AND (C_w > R_w when R_w < 1, else C_w >= R_w)]); otherwise it cannot be 1. A candidate timeout, missing image, missing required update, invalid transition implementation or nonfinite measurement fails the affected workload and yields 0, never a smaller denominator. Missing or invalid reference evidence is an evaluator qualification failure and blocks an authoritative result. There is no averaging across prompts, seeds or training runs, no relative improvement threshold, and no requirement concerning an aggregate score. A failure on any workload defeats the conjunction, as does a tie on a workload whose reference is below the scorer's maximum; on a ceiling workload (R_w == 1) the candidate must also reach 1, so equality passes only there.

solver_feedback.name: dev_eval_reward_ocr
solver_feedback.means: One scalar: the arithmetic mean of the candidate's own absolute OCR rewards over the complete, fixed public development evaluation set after its prescribed development training run. Use the same real models, update verification, 512-pixel images, 10 rollout steps, 40 evaluation steps and OCR scorer. This is the artifact's eval_reward_ocr on development data only. Return it after each completed train submission, without image-level rows or arrays; if development execution fails before a complete measurement, return null with failure status rather than inventing a reward. No private grading or final-evaluation measurements contribute to this scalar.
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it uses only candidate-generated images and public development data, with no reference value, private workload identity, ratio or difference.

solver_feedback.name: dev_verified_optimizer_updates
solver_feedback.means: One nonnegative integer: the number of actual, non-skipped optimizer updates verified in the candidate's fixed public development training run, returned after every train submission, including the completed count on failure. Count neither accumulation microsteps nor calls skipped by Accelerate or mixed-precision overflow. This is a development execution diagnostic, not an additional beats_reference metric.
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it counts only the candidate's public development execution and contains neither reference measurements nor private workload information.

statement_sentences: A separate, stricter beats_reference criterion accompanies the continuous score: after the same prescribed number of verified optimizer updates on the real single-teacher SD3.5 OCR distillation path, your implementation must achieve strictly higher OCR reward than the reference on every held-out prompt-and-seed workload whose reference is below the scorer's maximum, and must also reach the maximum where the reference already attains it. OCR reward is the released scorer's case- and space-normalized, capped Levenshtein similarity with its substring-success rule; every workload must pass; a tie fails except on a ceiling workload where both reach the maximum, and improvements on other workloads cannot compensate for a failure. Valid training and generation must execute on the evaluator's NVIDIA GPU, using 512-pixel images, 10 rollout steps and 40 evaluation steps, with no comparison tolerance. Train feedback includes your own absolute development OCR mean and verified update count plus aggregate criterion pass/fail counts and percentages; private workload identities, per-workload results, reference measurements and final-evaluation metrics are withheld.
comments:
Read reproduction.json before selecting the unit: accelerator_required is nvidia_gpu, and the smoke ran only real CPU OCR, corpus loading and imports, not SD3 generation or optimization. Checked AUTHORING_BRIEF.md, SOURCE.md, CONTRIBUTION.md, ARTIFACT_PLAN.json, evidence/contribution.md, the selected launcher/config, both excised sampling functions, scripts/train_sd3.py::eval and its rollout/replay/loss/update/save paths, rewards.py and ocr.py. The per-image OCR reward is already computed and exposed by the artifact; evaluating its individual observations preserves the paper's OCR quantity while preventing the reported evaluation mean from hiding prompt-level regressions. The continuous score can retain its separately specified behavior, but neither it nor eval_reward_ocr is an input to this conjunction. Withheld keys denote private train-grading measurements or final measurements, not the public development feedback key. The pipeline's permitted aggregate criterion counts/percentages remain separate from solver_feedback; per-workload pass booleans remain private. Final evaluation supplies no solver feedback.

Metric scope: this released configuration has only OCR with weight 1.0, so eval_reward_avg duplicates OCR rather than providing a second independent metric. Training KL, policy loss and clip fraction are optimization diagnostics, not independent reported quality outcomes for this selected contribution. No measured duration or second quality outcome is supplied for this single-teacher sampler scope; do not invent a speed score, turn the resource cap into a paper metric, or substitute a standalone SDE microbenchmark. The full paper's multi-teacher/MAR fidelity and reward tradeoffs cannot be claimed by this OCR-only task: requiring their outcomes would conflict with the selected execution spine and available qualification evidence and would require an explicit scope revision with genuine evaluators, not silently omitting one side of such a revised tradeoff. The comparison requires strict improvement of the selected OCR quantity below the scorer's maximum, and equality (the candidate also reaching the maximum) on ceiling workloads. No noise magnitude has been measured, so no tolerance or minimum improvement is justified. In particular R_w=1 is cleared only by the candidate also reaching 1 (equality passes there); do not drop such workloads, and do not relax ties on any workload whose reference is below the maximum.

Workload construction: use only upstream/dataset/ocr/train.txt and test.txt with their original prompt text. Define the duplicate key as lowercase text with whitespace runs collapsed and leading/trailing whitespace removed; retain the first occurrence. Define the target key exactly as the scorer does: prompt.split('"')[1].replace(' ', '').lower(). Exclude malformed or empty-target records before manifest freeze. Partition deduplicated test prompts into public development, private train-grading and private final sets by whole target-key groups, so the sets share neither normalized prompts nor normalized targets. Exclude from training every prompt or target key appearing anywhere in the original held-out test pool. A source-only audit found 19,653 training rows, 19,649 normalized unique training prompts, 1,018 normalized unique test prompts, no empty targets, and 17,307 unique training prompts after both overlap exclusions. This audit is not a performance measurement. Corpus deduplication must not remove the trainer's intentional repeated rollouts per prompt. Keep private selected prompts, seed assignments, reference outputs and manifest identities out of solver assets and feedback; do not export the retained evaluator's W&B image captions, raw logs or ordered reward arrays from private runs. Private evaluation randomness must be reset independently of each implementation's training RNG consumption, with identical initial evaluation latents for each paired workload; stochastic training realizations need not match between different valid integration rules. Pin batch grouping and numerical/runtime settings. Ensure loader padding or gathering never scores an image twice or drops a real workload.

Allowed surface and validity: The computational bodies of pipeline_with_logprob and sde_step_with_logprob are solver-editable, with new helper modules permitted under flow_grpo/frontier_solution/. Retain the existing module-level wiring and callable interfaces. Retain importable signatures, decoded-image output, ordered T+1 latent states, T per-sample log probabilities, optional transition means, supplied-next-latent scoring without resampling, and the step's next latent/mean/noise-coefficient/optional sqrt(-dt) returns. Validate the declared stochastic transition law, likelihood normalization as a mean over non-batch latent dimensions, and agreement of rollout and replay likelihoods at unchanged parameters. Checks must allow compatible integration/exploration changes rather than demand pixelwise equality with reference trajectories. Retain differentiability of replay means/log probabilities and verify genuine current-student trajectory collection, frozen teacher and base-anchor forwards, finite consumed losses/gradients, nonempty retained training batches, non-skipped optimizer updates and changed trainable LoRA weights. No cached images, synthetic latents replacing model execution, teacher-image substitution, extra private evaluation training or hidden model/trainer/scorer edits are valid. Preserve the SDE noise-coefficient return convention: the released Gaussian transition standard deviation is coefficient times sqrt(-dt), while the retained KL denominator uses coefficient squared without the timestep factor. A zero-noise evaluation transition is deterministic, not a Gaussian of positive variance; require finite states/images, score an on-support deterministic transition with a documented zero log-mass sentinel and an off-support supplied state with negative infinity, and never consume an undefined zero-variance density in a training ratio or KL denominator. Endpoint handling must not introduce noise into noise_level=0 evaluation or change retained loss semantics. The released sde branch still evaluates a zero-variance Gaussian during noise_level=0 evaluation, producing nonfinite unused log-probability slots; reference qualification must explicitly document replacing only those unused slots with the deterministic convention above, with decoded trajectories and training unchanged, or report the reference-versus-guard conflict rather than silently accepting it.

Execution and unresolved conflicts: retain scripts/single_node/sd3_opd_example.sh -> scripts/train_sd3.py and general_ocr_sd3_8gpu_opd, one released OCR teacher, reward_mode=kl_only, beta=0.04, base-model anchor, no MAR LoRA or merged initialization, guidance_scale=4.5, and the configured EMA evaluation behavior. The source's timestep_fraction=0.99 uses nine of the ten rollout transitions for training; do not silently change it. Preserve teacher loading, OCR scoring, inline KL/PPO computation and optimizer wiring byte-for-byte within contribution excision. Separately document and apply identical author-owned runtime adaptations for actual asset paths, bounded stopping/final evaluation/save, and any qualified single-process launch/unwrap/batch-group-accumulation changes. These adaptations must be resolved explicitly against retained-file requirements. The unbounded while True, eight-process launcher, transformer.module access, OCR zero-advantage filtering before kl_only, [B,1] KL advantage times [B] ratio broadcasting, and source-versus-paper timestep normalization are real qualification risks; do not hide a scientific correction as compatibility work or evade them by substituting gkd or a toy model. If unchanged semantics cannot satisfy validity and resource limits, report the conflict and block qualification. Count actual optimizer updates rather than global_step alone, stop at a qualified accumulation/EMA boundary, and evaluate only the prescribed endpoint, never a best checkpoint chosen using held-out results. Verify saved EMA adapter reload against the exact base; save_ckpt alone lacks optimizer, scheduler/RNG and independent EMA state, so a resumable checkpoint requires separately documented complete state capture. Preserve valid checkpoints and do not automatically replay trials merely to obtain a pass.

Deferred qualification: no reference or solver Evaluation, GPU launch, image publication or new phase is authorized here. The proposed single H100 80GB and at most 1,800 runner seconds are an initial qualification envelope, not measured feasibility or an OCR acceptance threshold. U, suite size, training group/accumulation settings, run-time limits and detectable improvement have no measured values in the supplied evidence; inventing them would conflict with the authoring brief. Populate and freeze them only from subsequently authorized genuine reference runs on the Driver-owned Verifier GPU runner, before candidate comparisons, with matching resource limits and no post-submission workload selection. The comparison above remains zero-tolerance: strictly greater below the maximum, equality permitted only where the reference is at the maximum. Use base revision b940f670f0eda2d07fbb75229e779da1ad11eb80 and OCR teacher revision 1a0e6426ac8b8f53347ac66d0d544a1fc2253791 from the authorized /work/flow-opd-assets paths. reproduction.json reports complete final integrity-manifest verification, superseding earlier staging uncertainty, but this review has not independently rehashed the assets; runtime must validate /work/flow-opd-assets/integrity-manifest.json and its file hashes before claiming materialization. Keep model weights and credentials out of tracked task files/build contexts; separate teacher redistribution review from scientific usability. Subsequent qualification remains subject to the brief's phase, cumulative budget/reserve, provider-routing, reservation/lock and cleanup controls; this source-only specification establishes neither GPU feasibility nor release readiness.
